backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining persistent state, access control, user profiles, work logs, DAO proposals, and utility functions for validations and ID generation.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report listing implemented features, involved files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file summarizing key frontend files and their roles in styling, authentication, dashboard UI, contributions, and governance.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining color variables, theme tokens, and dark mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the root element and main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication, profile setup gating, and rendering the dashboard with theming.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button integrating Internet Identity with loading states and styled UI.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting new users to enter and save their display name before continuing.
frontend/src/components/contributions/Co: Container with tabs to create and view work logs for the proof‑of‑contribution system.
frontend/src/components/contributions/Wo: Form component for creating a work log, collecting category, description, and time range, then submitting via mutation.
Displays and sorts work logs, showing details and allowing non-owners to verify logs via mutation.
frontend/src/components/governance/Gover: Wrapper UI providing tabs for viewing and creating governance proposals.
frontend/src/components/governance/Propo: Form for submitting a new proposal with title, description, budget, and auto-generated start time.
Lists proposals with phase status, countdown, budget, and vote statistics, sorted by start time.
App layout with header, footer, branding, login button, and content wrapper.
frontend/src/components/profile/UserProf: Displays user profile, citizen ID status, and allows onboarding if not registered.
frontend/src/components/wallet/TokenWall: Displays the user's token balance and provides a form to transfer SUZHI tokens using Internet Identity and actor hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Fetches the current caller's user profile once an authenticated actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication state and login/logout handling through Internet Identity using a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for citizen onboarding, wallet operations, and work log CRUD using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and custom color variables/theme for the frontend.
frontend/src/lib/governance.ts: Computes proposal phases and countdown strings based on start time and fixed discussion/voting durations.
frontend/src/lib/workLog.ts: Provides helper functions to label categories/statuses and format work log time spans.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main dashboard UI with tabs for profile, wallet, contributions, and governance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them when needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and theme extensions for the project’s UI.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s overall state, architecture notes, known issues, and tracked feature requirements for the SUZHI dApp.
